mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines in the prior 3 months but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% but S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the prior 2 months but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side expansion (INDPRO growth above 0.5% monthly), manufacturing output growth supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO monthly growth exceeds 0.5% but S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST increases in the prior 3 months but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5% but S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signals a deepening economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS < 3.5% but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% annually), the Federal Reserve's policy shift reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% but S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
